content.comment_body: Hello, We have used the [product_name] model with article number [article_no] for a long time. Recently, our supplier informed us that it is discontinued and recommended a replacement with article number [article_no]. They assured us functionality remains the same, but we are experiencing problems connecting to the new device. When attempting to connect and upload the program from our laptop, we receive this message: "Unable to access the Remote device" Testing with the previous model works fine. Please advise on how to successfully upload the program to the new hardware. Both models appear identical aside from a single digit difference in the article number.
Hello, This resource could be useful: [url] Best regards, [user_name]

The [product_name] with article number [article_no] is the latest version and requires the current software release [version_no] for compatibility. Older software versions (such as [version_no]) are not compatible with the new hardware. You can obtain the required upgrade from the manufacturer's website. Reference the download links for up-to-date software and firmware.

analysis.insight_summary: Users faced compatibility problems when upgrading to a newer PLC model. Although hardware appears almost identical and buyers were assured the devices are equivalent, older software cannot connect to new hardware, resulting in error messages that do not clearly mention the software version mismatch, causing confusion.
analysis.user_expectations: Users expect straightforward program uploading and operation across two almost identical PLC models, with no significant configuration changes required.
